semiconductor_relevance: High — Speedfam Co., Ltd. specializes in precision planarization technology and equipment for semiconductor manufacturing.
summary: Speedfam Co., Ltd. is a leading provider of precision planarization equipment, including lapping, grinding, and polishing machines for semiconductor wafers. With over 30 years of experience, the company offers a comprehensive range of solutions, including process development and technical services tailored to meet customer needs.

regional_presence.Taiwan: Speedfam Taiwan has accumulated sales of more than 5,000 models, indicating a strong presence in the region.
